registrations.title: Registrations
registrations.description: Review new employee and vendor account requests. Nobody gets access until approved here.
registrations.emptyBody: New requests will appear as soon as applicants verify their email.
registrations.selectPrompt: Select a request to review its details.
registrations.approveBodyUser: The account becomes an Employee. Assign their branch now, or later from Employees — they can't submit expenses until assigned.
registrations.approveBodyVendor: The account becomes a Vendor. Select the branches they supply — they can't invoice until at least one is assigned.
registrations.noBranches: No active branches exist yet. You can approve now and assign branches after creating them.
registrations.rejectBody: The applicant will be signed out and shown a rejection notice.
registrations.publicMessage: Message to applicant (optional, visible to them)
registrations.infoBody: The applicant sees this message on their status screen.
